data.one_liner: An animated progress bar widget designed to be used with audio or video.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable animated progress bar widget designed to integrate with audio or video media players. It offers a controller to manage progress, buffer, seeking, and smooth transition animations between collapsed and expanded states.
use_when: You are building an audio or video player interface in Flutter.
You want a progress bar that expands and animates its thumb or track based on user interaction or playback.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose linear progress indicator unrelated to media playback.
You are looking for a complete audio/video playback engine.
strengths: Provides full control over bar and thumb expansions via ProgressBarController.
Thumb components are painted above all widgets using an overlay strategy for fancy effects.
weaknesses: Does not play any media by itself and requires external media handling.
Limited documentation on advanced configurations beyond basic properties.
